note: 6.2.1 candidate receipt (v6.2.0 is a preserved failed tag — nothing was published; the prepublish architecture ratchet caught a one-line drift in content_layout.py after a local type-narrowing fix skipped the ratchet re-run; the bare tag 6.2.0 was pushed against naming convention and its run was cancelled before any gate completed, also with nothing published). One new public default-profile tool, add_equation, inserts native <hp:equation> objects: LaTeX input is converted to Hancom EqEdit script through a render-verified token set (anything outside it is refused with EQUATION_LATEX_UNSUPPORTED — no silent approximation), raw EqEdit script is accepted as the honest low level, placement targets an appended paragraph, an existing paragraph, or a table cell, and the response carries the reader-direction round-trip (readerLatex). Every emitted spelling was pixel-verified against a live Hancom render oracle (60-probe token battery); spellings the real build refuses (to, iint/iiint, vmatrix/Vmatrix, Bmatrix, widehat/widetilde, limsup/liminf) are replaced or typed-refused, and the render-verified Hancom vocabulary (dint, tint, FORALL, dmatrix) also joined the reader token maps.

inputParameters.name: latex
inputParameters.description: LaTeX math fragment; converted through the render-verified token set, refused outside it.

inputParameters.name: script
inputParameters.description: Raw EqEdit script stored verbatim; exactly one of latex/script.

inputParameters.name: base_unit
inputParameters.description: Equation base font size in 1/100 pt (default 1100).

coreDependency.capability: hwpx.HwpxDocument.add_equation (experimental contract) + hwpx.equation.latex_to_eqedit typed-refusal converter + reader token-map growth (dint/tint/FORALL/dmatrix)
coreDependency.failClosed: Empty/oversized scripts raise before any write; unsupported LaTeX raises typed EQUATION_LATEX_UNSUPPORTED; invalid targets raise EQUATION_TARGET_INVALID / TABLE_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE / PARAGRAPH_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE. The candidate distribution requires python-hwpx>=5.2.0, the first public core with the equation authoring primitive.

proof: Holding every existing tool fixed, the canonical payload delta is confined to the dependency/version floors and one added public default-profile mutating tool, add_equation (edit domain). No tool is removed, renamed, reclassified, or moved between profiles; every existing input/output schema is unchanged. The added tool's engine emission follows the hp:equation contract reverse-engineered from real Hancom gold documents, its authoring vocabulary is pixel-verified per token against a live Hancom render oracle, and the author→read fixed point through the unchanged eqedit_to_latex reader is regression-locked in both repositories.
